decision.rule: certify only when every exact objective denominator and every shared closure control is independently recomputed as proven

nonClaims: The replay proves the 17 objective rows; backlog and release authority remain separate shared controls.
Runner publication alone is not approval; this verdict uses the 23-row replay.
Component quality receipts do not substitute for the exact 29-row replay.
Foundation replay alone is not final certification; the independent objective verdict supplies the terminal authority.

backlogCensus.nonClaim: Deferred items are explicitly waived into follow-up ownership; this does not claim that those bugs are fixed or retired.

releasePushProvenance.nonClaim: The bound release commit must remain an ancestor of origin/main; later unrelated commits do not invalidate its proven release surfaces.

independentReview.nonClaim: The canonical certificate consumes the independent verdict but recomputes its required dimensions and reviewer count.

legacyAuthority.retirementRule: Any missing, stale, contradictory, unreachable, unresolved, or unknown input restores legacy authority and changes this certificate to not-certified.
